name: Titan’s Wheel Trap (CR 3)
body:
Type mechanical; Perception DC 15; Disable Device DC 28

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset automatic
Effect Atk +20 melee (masterwork manacles lock on any size Small yo Large victim, binding him and dragging him into the machinery. Captured victim suffers 5d6 points of bludgeoning damage every 1d4 rounds as the wheel spins.
